purpose: v0.2.30 /orprovider, Codex round 1 R1 (2026-09-19): ToolModels.swift gains one sentence in agentModelParameter(), rendered only while an /orprovider host pin is set on the OpenRouter provider (SubagentModelLanes.hostPinBypass): the Agent tool's model description then says only 'inherit' is available because the user pinned OpenRouter to one host, so every subagent runs the main model there and the cheap lanes are bypassed until release. A schema prompt string only, shown for no fixture (fixtures never pin); no persisted model in that file changed and every other digest is identical to the web-subagent manifest. Requires independent review with the /orprovider corrections (private-docs OPENCODE_CATALOG_TRIM_2026-09-19.md, Codex round 1). Codex round 2 (wording): the same sentence now states the Web-researcher exception and tells the agent to leave the parameter unset rather than pass model=inherit; still a schema prompt string shown for no fixture. Researcher-on-main-model (2026-09-25, owner decision): the same pinned-only sentence now says the Web researcher is included (it runs the main model since this change, so it carries the pin); still a schema prompt string shown for no fixture, ToolModels.swift digest only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). OpenRouter lane without OpenAI (2026-09-25, owner decision): ToolModels.swift routes generate_image and transcribe_media through MediaRouting — with an OpenAI key the OpenAI/Gemini schemas are byte-identical; only on the OpenRouter lane without an OpenAI key the Gemini-via-OpenRouter image schema and an OpenRouter transcribe_media description are shown (defined outside this file). Schema selection only, no persisted field; ToolModels.swift digest only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). Explicit image send (2026-09-25, owner decision): the Gemini and OpenAI generate_image descriptions in ToolModels.swift replace/gain one sentence saying the image is saved and shown to the model, not sent to the user automatically, and to use send_document_to_chat to share it (wire migration r11, image_explicit_send_migration.py). A schema prompt string only, no persisted field; ToolModels.swift digest only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). Mid-turn early wake release 1a (2026-09-26, owner authorization; plan v7 §3.11/§3.12.1): ToolModels.swift gains OutcomeBinding, an additive optional ToolResultMessage.outcomeBinding encoded only when set (results of recorded background bash jobs, the Responses crash placeholder, suppressed and blocked calls; a malformed value decodes as unbound, never a load failure; never on the wire), and HarnessBackgroundStatus, an additive optional HarnessAnnotation.backgroundStatus omitted when nil (only on mid-turn deliveries made while background jobs run). HarnessAnnotations.swift renders that status as a separate harness block after the direct-user block and keeps it through canonicalization. ToolModels.swift and HarnessAnnotations.swift digests only; every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). Compaction-summary bounds (2026-09-28, owner-approved minimal scope): ToolModels.swift gains a trailing optional associated value LLMResponse.text(..., finishReason: String? = nil) with a doc comment. LLMResponse is an in-memory transport result, never encoded or persisted; the Chat Completions decoder fills it from choice.finish_reason so bounded compaction summaries can refuse a cut-off reply. No persisted model or field changed; ToolModels.swift digest only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). Mid-turn round delivery of background results (2026-09-28, owner-approved plan MIDTURN_ROUND_DELIVERY v3, owner decision D-A): ToolModels.swift gains ToolResultMessage.deliveredCompletions, an additive optional [UUID] of the completion message ids whose bodies Briglia appended to that result's content at a tool-round boundary. Encoded only when non-empty (every ordinary result encodes byte-identically; no fixture contains it), decoded lossily (a malformed value is empty, never a load failure), never rendered and never read by the provider request builders; recovery bookkeeping only. ToolModels.swift digest only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). Past-turn summary retention, Part B (2026-10-02, owner-approved plan SUMMARY_BOUNDS_AND_RETENTION v5): Message.swift gains two additive fields, prunedContextSummaryCoverage (PruneSummaryCoverage?, encoded only when set) and demotedPruneSummaries ([DemotedPruneSummary], encoded only when non-empty), plus two computed helpers (renderedPruneArchiveReferences, demotedSummaryNotes) and the matching displayTokenCount term. Both fields decode leniently (an invalid coverage is absent, a malformed record is dropped; never a load failure) and are included in ==. Every message without them encodes byte-identically; no fixture contains them. Coverage is never rendered; a demoted record renders as one metadata line only after a prune demotes an anchor older than the newest three. Message.swift digest only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting). Rejected/unsupported images (2026-10-09, owner-approved plan CACHE_KEY_AND_IMAGE_REJECTION v2, Codex round 2): ToolModels.swift gains FileAttachment.providerRejected (in-memory only, never encoded) and FileAttachmentReference.providerRejected (Bool?, encoded only when set, decoded leniently: a malformed value is absent, never a load failure); Message.swift gains providerRejectedImageFileNames ([String], encoded only when non-empty, decoded leniently, included in ==). A mark means only 'excluded during image-rejection recovery': the request builders send a note in place of the marked image; files and snapshots are untouched. Every unmarked reference and message encodes byte-identically; no fixture contains them. Message.swift and ToolModels.swift digests only, every other digest unchanged (asserted before rewriting).
